title: Shiraishi An — Those Precious To Me〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: This is so cool! I get to meet the real live VIRTUAL SINGERS Miku and Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: O-Okay! Um, I'll think about what we can talk about, so you think too!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay!
Hehehe, what should we talk about?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
(Miku! What's going on?!
An shrunk, and she's forgotten all about us!)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (This is just a hunch, but I think the owner of this SEKAI's feelings is An herself.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (That's why she's been so strongly affected by the feelings that make this place up.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
(I thought so too, but...
Why would An's own feelings be so mean to her like that?)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (For now, let's focus on talking with An.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Part of her or not, these emotions shouldn't be able to remove her memories completely. She should remember while we're talking.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Sorry for the wait. An, we'd love to know more about you. Is that okay?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay, can you tell us what your favorite things are?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
My favorite thing is singing!
Daddy teaches me all kinds of things!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Daddy's really good at singing too!
He's on a team with his friends, and they're called—

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Huh? Who were they...?
I know he told me the team name, too...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Why am I the only one in those pictures?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The folks from Vivid Street and Aunt Nagi should be in those, too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay, can you tell me about your team, then?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, right! We're Vivid BAD SQUAD!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Me and Kohane, and Akito and Toya! The four of us want to put on an event bigger and better than RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Just like I thought, her memories aren't totally gone.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: An! I'd like to know more about RAD WEEKEND. What kind of event was it?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I watched it with lots of people I really like, but... I can't remember it very well...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Um, Daddy was there too, and...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
It's a really...really precious memory...
But I can't remember...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: An. Do you want those memories back?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah!
They're really important memories to me!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Even if it will make you feel sadder than you do right now?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Miku, you don't have to say it like that...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: These feelings didn't remove her memories, but they did affect them. Which means...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Even if only a little bit, some part of An feels like things might be better this way.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Then, what that other An said earlier...

rows.Speaker: An?
rows.Line: Even Aunt Nagi left me all by myself...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Those, too, are feelings An has inside her.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
An, what do you want to do?
You get to decide.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I know these memories are precious to me... I do, but...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I want to remember, but I don't at the same time!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I don't know what I should do!!!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: When you were hurting, I was right beside you, but I couldn't do anything for you.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
This time, I'm here for you!
I won't leave you alone!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I believe you'll figure out a way to get there. The place Nagi wasn't able to reach.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I won't forget Aunt Nagi, Uncle Taiga, or anyone from Vivid Street!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Because I promised! To shoulder Aunt Nagi's feelings...everyone's feelings!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I swear we'll take them there!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: To go where Aunt Nagi couldn't, beyond her dream!!!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thank you.
You helped me remember what's precious to me, Rin.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thank you, too, Miku.
I'm okay now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hey, the An from this SEKAI.
You're watching, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Because it's true, there have been times when I've thought it would be easier if I could forget it all.

rows.Speaker: Another An
rows.Line: So you'll just forgive them, just that easily?

rows.Speaker: Another An
rows.Line: Daddy, Uncle Taiga and everyone else from Vivid Street who lied to us, and Aunt Nagi...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I cried a lot, and screamed a lot, and I really resented them too...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But... In the end, I just can't help but love Dad and everyone.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And no matter how much I cry, it won't bring Aunt Nagi back.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But her feelings... Her dream. Those are still with me, and I can carry them with me.

rows.Speaker: Another An
rows.Line:
I see...
I guess you don't need me anymore, then.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, that's not it at all.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I want to remember it all. The sadness and pain I felt back then, enough to make me want to forget everything.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If I forgot, that's when I feel like Aunt Nagi would really go away.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So I plan to remember forever, until the day I die, and when I'm face to face with Aunt Nagi again, I'll tell her...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: “I bet you think you're sooo clever!”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Miku, Rin, I really have to thank you.
If you hadn't been with me, things might have gotten really bad there.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
You can say that again!
I hope you think twice about picking stuff up off the ground from now on!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, what now? We were going to practice, but want to call it for today and rest up at MEIKO's?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No. If it's okay with you two, I'd like to practice. That other me really lit a fire under me, after all!
